newsitem.title: USA: Mity-Lite to buy 49.9 pct of DO Group.
newsitem.headline: Mity-Lite to buy 49.9 pct of DO Group.

text.p: Mity-Lite Inc, a maker of multipurpose furniture, said Wednesday it will buy a 49.9 percent stake in DO Group Inc, a privately-held maker of office seating and panel systems for $750,000 cash.
Mity-Lite said it will also make a $1.0 million loan in the form of senior subordinated debt to a unit of DO Group.
Mity-Lite added it will have an option to put back the shares to officers of Do Group any any time during the next three years.
At the end of the three-year period, the majority owners of Do Group will have the right to convert their shares into 115,000 shares of Mity-Lite, it said.
The acquisition will be treated for accounting purposes as a purchase, it said.
